    Applications are now being accepted for immediate vacancies and to replenish the waiting list. Individuals or households who meet the income and household size
    requirements listed in the table below may apply. Qualified applicants will be required to meet additional selection criteria such as asset limits. Applicants who meet
                                   the requirement for mobility or visual/hearing adapted units will be prioritized as units become available.

                                                                                                      How Do You Apply?
                                                                        Applications may be requested in person or by mailing a self-addressed envelope to:

                                                                                                       1755 Watson Ave LLC
                                                                                                C/o Spring Leasing and Management
                                                                                                   401 Franklin Avenue, Suite 314
                                                                                                       Garden City, NY 11530

                                                         Applications may also be requested by emailing marketing@springmanagement.net or by calling 516-665-0015.
                                                                                        What Happens After You Submit an Application?
Applications are logged in the order in which they are received. As units become available, applicants on the waiting list who appear to qualify will be contacted to
submit documents that verify their household size, identity of members of the household and household income.
